headline: You can’t tell the story of hip-hop without the talk box shows how the talk box became LA
body: You can’t tell the story of hip-hop without the talk box shows how the talk box became LA hip-hop’s most-defining instrument for ‘How LA Found Its Sound,’ sponsored by FX’s ‘The Drop: A Snowfall Saga.’ Now streaming on Hulu. FXPartner.
